escalations.subject: source_id for steward-extracted, non-legacy packets
escalations.statement: This packet is recorded under dmg-legacy-unspecified because that is the only source_id registered for the DMG and an Analyst may not add a registry entry. Its registered provenance is 'legacy graph dump', which is false for this packet: the text was supplied fresh by the repository source steward under DEC-2026-0029.
escalations.why_it_matters: DEC-2026-0029 forbids legacy canonical data and archive extraction batches as source-read evidence, and this packet exists specifically to supply evidence that is not legacy. A reader who takes source_id at face value would conclude the opposite of what is true, on the one reading where that distinction decides whether the work is admissible. The same mismatch already sits under every PHB packet, so the fix is a registry change, not a packet field.
escalations.analyst_position: Register a source_id whose provenance names steward intake, and record which packets were extracted under it. Raised here rather than earlier because this is the first packet where the label actively contradicts the governing Decision.
